00-intro
The command palette puts the actions for the page you're on into one searchable list.
01-open
Press Command K on any page to open it, or choose Command palette from the user menu.
02-search
Type to filter the list. The arrow keys move the selection, and Enter runs it.
03-page
On a workflow page, that workflow's actions come first: copy its ID, its run ID, or the CLI command.
04-paste
Paste a workflow ID and press Enter to go straight to that workflow.
05-actions
Many rows have more than one action. Command K lists them all, and Command Enter runs the second.
06-confirm
Terminate asks you to press Enter a second time. When an action isn't available, the row says why.
07-scopes
To narrow the list, type a set's letter and a space, like G for Go to. Tab moves between scopes, and the chip opens a picker.
08-views
Some tools open their own list. Switch namespace shows every namespace you can reach, and Escape takes you back.
09-recent
Items you've used appear under Recent at the top, and the rest of the list keeps its order.
10-prefs
You can change the theme or the timezone, or search the docs, from the same place.
11-dev
Dev tools appear only on local and staging builds, with a DEV tag so no one mistakes them for user features.
12-touch
On a phone, every row and action has a tap target.
13-outro
That's the command palette. Press Command K to try it.
